newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex lowered to hold.

text.p: An Abaco analyst lowered her rating on Telefonos de Mexico SA (Telmex) stock to a hold from a buy, the brokerage said in a statement on Tuesday.
Analyst Claudia Gonzalez said the main reason for the downgrade was that she thought the Mexican telecommunications company's shares were fairly valued at about $40 per ADR.
In New York, the ADRs closed down 3/8 at 39-1/2.
She lowered her estimate of the company's 1997 earnings to $3.55 per ADR from $3.73, mostly because competitors have been forcing down rates on domestic long-distance calls.
